pages.title: Archipelago Igloos – Luxory Glass Igloos In Helsinki and Sipoo Archipelago
pages.description: We offer unique eco-friendly accommodation experience in floating glass igloos in Helsinki and Sipoo archipelago.
pages.text:
Archipelago Igloos Luxory Glass Igloos In Helsinki and Sipoo Archipelago
Hoppa till innehåll
Your adventure begins here
Archipelago Igloos offers unique eco-friendly accommodation experience alongside fascinating natural attractions. We are located in the archipelago surrounding Helsinki. Summer season our floating hotel unit is anchored at the bay between Vallisaari and Kuninkaansaari.
Summer location: Vallisaari/ Kuninkaansaari Island
Discover unlimited beauty
Archipelago Igloos is a luxurious suite for two. The floating igloo is equipped for a comfortable and adventurous holiday. The biggest feature is the unobstructed floor to ceiling view of the sky and the outside.
The glass igloo is equipped with a double bed, a kitchen, a foldable dining table, food storage and toilet. On the terrace you have a gas grill, swimming ladder and a rowing boat at your disposal. You also have access to SUP boards and kick bikes during summer season.
In wintertime kick sleds, snowshoes and fishing gear is included. For an extra fee you can join us on a snowmobile tour in the archipelago or try ice floating with survival suites.
Explore the nature
The location of our floating glass igloos change during the year. When the sea freezes in wintertime we move our location east of Helsinki to Sipoo archipelago where the ice gets thick and safe.
Location of the floating hotel
During summer you can find the igloos at the bay between Vallisaari and Kuninkaansaari islands, only 15 minutes from Helsinki citycenter. Transport to the island either by public ferry or private boat transfer from the citycenter.
During winter the glass igloos are located in Sipoo archipelago, just 30 minutes by car from the city centre. The igloo is located 300 meters from the mainland on the south side of an island. Meetingpoint: Our snowmobile base at Katrineholmintie 96. From the mainland you can either walk or take the kick sleds out to the igloo.
Summer in Helsinki archipelago
(4.5-30.9) Summertime experience in Helsinki archipelago at Vallisaari and Kuninkaansaari islands.
Included activities: fishing, kick bikes, SUP boards.
Public ferry to Vallisaari island or a private boat pickup out to the island, you choose!
We can do the private boat pickup as a longer sightseeing tour for an extra fee.
Summertime meeting point for the private boat transfer out to the Igloo is at Katajanokka guest harbour, Kanavaranta 4, Helsinki.
The public ferry leaves from Lyypekinlaituri behind the Old Market Hall.
Book your adventure from here: https://2ndhomes.holidayfuture.com

pages.title: Summer Location – Archipelago Igloos
pages.text:
Summer Location Archipelago Igloos
Hoppa till innehåll
Helsinki Archipelago
During summer (4.5-30.10) the glass igloos are located at the bay between Vallisaari and Kuninkaansaari island. You can can reach Vallisaari island with a public ferry.
Public transfer
The public ferry leaves from Lyypekinlaituri. From the arrival jetty you need to walk 400 meters to Torpedolahti where you find the rowing boat that you can row out to the igloo.
The public ferry back to Helsinki citycenter leaves from Torpedolahti (where the igloo is located). You can check out the schedules for the public transport here: https://www.frs-finland.fi/vallisaari-en/
Please inform us your preferred check in time during booking.
About the accommodation
You can bring your own food if you want. For cooking dinner the Igloo has a small kitchen at your disposal. The small gas stove is good for boiling water. There is no owen in the kitchen. We recommend using the outdoor grill on the terrace for a barbecue.
If you don t want to cook yourself there are some restaurants and cafeterias on the island.
What to do during your stay
Enjoy the nature, try fishing, cook the fish the grill, relax, go swimming, rowing or paddling and read a book. If you get bored there is also free WiFi in the Igloo. And you can always book a boat sightseeing tour with us around Helsinki archipelago.
